About our necklaces

Most necklaces here are a pendant on a chain, and the chain length decides how it sits. The majority of our listings use a 50 cm chain, which falls a little below the collarbone on most people. A 45 cm chain sits higher, and a few styles come on 55 cm or 60 cm chains for a longer drop. The length is written in each product description, so check it before you buy.

A pendant necklace can be a small heart, moon or star to larger crystal and glass cabochon designs. Small pendants suit a plain neckline, and bigger statement pieces look best on their own rather than layered. If you like to layer, pick two chains with different pendant sizes and a few centimetres between them. Silver, gold and rose gold colours are all available, and they are plated rather than solid.

The range is mostly silver-plated alloy, with some stainless steel pieces, faux stones and glass. Each description lists the pendant and chain material, and a number of chains are listed as 925 sterling silver. If you wear jewellery all day, look for the material line rather than assuming.

Chains and pendants can be mixed. A plain chain necklace is a quiet backdrop for a larger pendant, while a pendant with a crystal centre needs little else. Look at the pendant size in the description as well as the chain length, because a 4 cm pendant looks very different from a 2 cm one.

To keep a necklace looking good, store it flat or hung so the chains do not tangle, and put it on after perfume and moisturiser rather than before.

If you are shopping by theme, we also have separate pages for aromatherapy diffuser necklaces, harmony ball necklaces, chakra pieces, glow in the dark pendants, photo lockets and friendship necklaces.

Shipping within Australia is a flat $7.95, and free on orders over $60. You can return items within 14 days.
